declarationTiming: written before execution of the new W01-W43 qualification harness

candidateDefinitions.F: fresh model process group per Attempt; accepted D0014 immutable preparation reuse remains allowed
candidateDefinitions.WH: long-lived trusted tdev/ GitRepositoryModelExecutor host with bounded D0014 preparation reuse; D0017 reference/carrier rebuilt and reauthorized per invocation; actual model process remains fresh per Attempt
candidateDefinitions.WI: long-lived host with a new disposable isolate per Attempt
candidateDefinitions.WP: same model/runtime process reused across Attempts

supportedProfile.platformUnderThisRun: Termux Android/arm64 POSIX process-group semantics where supported
supportedProfile.hostReuse: one GitRepositoryModelExecutor instance and its bounded exact-key immutable preparation cache

benchmarkPlan.workload: same exact current repository HEAD and one observation Task through current D0017 request/context path with a deterministic local Node worker; no real model inference/provider round-trip
benchmarkPlan.stopGate: stop interpretation if any semantic/differential invariant fails; no wall-clock latency threshold is a pass/fail gate
